help_drive_connection: Connect your Google account to store full backups in your personal Google Drive. A green 'Connected' chip means the link is working. If you set this up on a different PC than the server, copy the shown sign-in link to the server browser.
help_automation_settings: Automated backups run only when Drive is connected. Frequency is based on time since the last backup (not a fixed clock time). Custom cron allows advanced scheduling (falls back to +1 day if the expression is invalid).
help_backup_status: Shows the last attempt/result, the last successful backup time, and the next scheduled time (up to 10 minutes early/late). If the PC was off, the due backup runs on the next startup.
help_local_export_import: Create a local JSON backup or restore from one. Export includes categories, products, customers, suppliers, sales, purchases, sale returns, expenses, cash shifts and users (password hashes). Merge adds/updates data; Replace Everything deletes all current data and cannot be undone.
help_restore_from_drive: Recover from Drive backups on a new PC or after data loss. JSON backups restore immediately (Merge or Replace). Database (.db) backups require an app restart and the old database is saved as lumipos.db.pre-restore; license keys are machine-specific and not restored.
help_local_export: Export everything to a single JSON file you can store offline (USB/external drive). This is safe and works without internet.
help_local_import: Restore from a previously exported JSON file. Choose Merge to keep existing data, or Replace Everything to fully overwrite it (irreversible).
help_system_data_backup: One-click snapshot of all business data, saved to this PC as a JSON file. No internet or Google Drive needed. Keep the file on a USB stick or a second cloud folder. To put the data back later, use Backup and Restore > Local Export and Import.
help_old_sales_cleanup: Permanently erases sales older than one year, together with their returns, payments and stock-movement records, so the database stays small. It cannot be undone, and reports for those dates will no longer include those sales. Take a backup first. Note: deleting old sales does not return stock to inventory.
